correctness.rationale: Read RESULT.md proof and verify.py. Dualizing the forbidden full stars yields a cover whose intersections are simplices when at least two ground vertices remain; nerve is the (n-3)-skeleton of the (n-1)-simplex. Integral augmented Cech chains preserve the S_n action. Its top homology is sign_n tensor (Z^n/Zdiag); integral dual is sign_n tensor the coordinate-sum kernel, not the quotient. Complementation on m=binom(n,2) edges contributes sign_E=sign_n^(n-2), so reduced H_{binom(n-1,2)-1}=sign_n^(n-1) tensor U_n and other reduced groups vanish for every n>=3. Independent exact signed Lefschetz calculations on all 15 partitions of n=3,4,5 matched the character; source verifier checks 26 classes n<=6 and mod-2 homology n<=5. The proof, not finite tests, proves the integral lattice, including n=3.
residual_risks: Integral augmentation and quotient permutation lattices differ; their duality is essential.
The derived character alone does not imply the integral module; the actual equivariant Cech and Alexander-dual identifications were inspected.
